title: Repairing a Pitch Mark When Ball is Off the Green
question: Your ball lies just off the putting green and there is a pitch mark on the green directly on your line of play. Before playing your next stroke, are you allowed to repair the pitch mark?

choices.text: No. You can only repair damage if your ball is on the putting green.
Yes. Damage on the putting green may be repaired at any time, even if your ball is off the green.
Yes, but only if another player gives permission.
No. Repairing the pitch mark would improve your line of play.

explanation: According to Rule 13.1c(2), a player is allowed to repair almost any damage on the putting green at any time, regardless of where their ball lies. This includes repairing pitch marks directly on your line of play, even if your ball is off the putting green. The only restriction is not to cause undue delay when making the repair.
